race.description: Creightons Funeral Service Provincial Mdn Plate
race.comment: PONZI SCHEME (8) has the right profile to break through after a solid third at Moruya, where he was beaten just over two lengths on soft ground and showed the benefit of being second-up. The rise from country company into a harder provincial assignment is noted, but he has already placed at this distance and has upside from a soft draw. HIDDEN NEWS (7) is the clear danger after going under narrowly at Newcastle, with the late hold-up adding merit to that second. Unlucky not to finish closer last start and shapes as the main threat. READY MADE HEIR (5) has the most exposed placing record, comes off a Port Macquarie second as favourite and gets first-time blinkers, although repeated placings rather than wins keep some caution in the assessment. Can hold a position and due for a change of luck. WE ARE ONE (12) Playing God filly from Truly Belong who debuts after a series of five trials for the Brad Widdup yard. Well drawn with leading jockey booked. Keeps safe.
